findings.summary: Multiline sensitive exception text can survive the existing non-DOTALL redactor and reach failure receipts/CLI.
findings.evidence: The first substitution's .* does not consume a newline; a second non-numeric short line is not removed by the other substitution or truncation.

findings.summary: A stop_fault exception can prevent return of already-caught budget errors, and the controller does not recover existing cached watch.error/stop snapshots.
findings.evidence: _bounded_fault_stop stores a caught error in a local list before calling stop_fault; if the call raises, tuple assignment never completes and only stop_exception remains.

findings.summary: N4 snapshot validation can raise before the optional controller_failure receipt is loaded into a case record.
findings.evidence: The N4 _require path precedes the return expression that reads controller_failure.json.

coverage_gaps.gap: No combined obtained-row/scope-exit/final-trace/receipt exception case and no partial receipt write.
N1 fixture has no fault watch; N4 stop exception retention/counts are not demonstrated.
Loading/new helper scenarios omit N4; sensitive text cases are single-line.
